title: Clean JSON from a messy model
summary: The model wraps JSON in chatter, gets types wrong, or fails. Return clean data every time.
hints: Don't json.loads the whole reply. Find the part from the first { to the last }.
Write one small function per fix: strip fences, find the object, remove trailing commas, coerce types. Then validate every key.
Wrap parse + validate in a loop of at most 3 attempts. When it fails, put the error message into the next prompt.
